name: 選択した連絡先への一括操作帯
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied HubSpot bulk-action toolbar as a faithful Japanese localization. The exact crop is 1707x51 pixels (33.47:1), an extremely wide and shallow row. Keep every control on one line with the source's compact height, broad horizontal distribution, and exact left-to-right order. Do not add the surrounding table, page heading, search controls, or menu contents.

At the left, show 「2件のコンタクトを選択中」 in dark text. Next show a small lock icon and muted disabled action 「レコードを補完」 in light blue-gray. Then show the enabled teal actions in order: a small right arrow and 「割り当て」; a small pencil and 「編集」; a small trash icon and 「削除」; a small plus and 「タスクを作成」; a small lock and 「シーケンスに登録」; 「その他」 followed by a small downward caret. At the far right, show the large pale blue-gray close X.

Preserve the source's white-to-pale-gray toolbar background, compact sans-serif type, teal enabled actions, muted disabled Enrich action, subtle shadow or separator, icon size, spacing, and 1707x51 aspect ratio without blank bands. Keep all labels on one line. No pills, filled buttons, extra controls, extra text, or a different action order. Use the crop as the authority for alignment, action states, and icon positions.
reviewNotes: v001 retains the selected-contact count, disabled Enrich state, Assign/Edit/Delete/Create tasks/Enroll in sequence/More actions, and close control. The output is 2172x724 (3:1) with large blank bands versus the source 1707x51 (33.47:1). Earlier ultra-wide cases returned similarly constrained canvases and second reframes did not correct them; recorded needs-correction after one evidence-based attempt.
